$comment: Single source of truth for scene timing. Read by the Vue interactive story (frontend/src/experiences/cinematic) and by the Remotion cut (video/remotion). Times are seconds from the start of the film. Narration lives in narration.json; colours in visual-tokens.json.
title: The Scan That Changed Everything
subtitle: How Machines Learn to See What We Cannot
disclaimer: RadiologyML, its scores and every medical image in this film are fictional and synthetic. AI output is not a diagnosis; clinicians make clinical decisions.

scenes.title: The Hospital Never Sleeps
scenes.intent: Build atmosphere: scale, rain, a building full of light and work. No technical words yet.

shots.description: High wide over the rain-soaked campus; the hospital tower glows against the city.
Slow dolly toward the third-floor radiology window; monitors flicker inside.
The camera passes through the glass without a cut and settles inside the lab.

transition.description: Real geometry: the lab exists behind the window.

scenes.title: Meet Noé
scenes.intent: Introduce Noé through action. His face moves from curiosity to concern as the wall of scans keeps growing.

shots.description: Side tracking shot: Noé walks in carrying his tablet, glancing at radiologists at their desks.
Over-the-shoulder: focus racks from Noé's face to the scan wall streaming thumbnails.
Close on Noé: curiosity becomes concern.

audio.ambience: lab room tone, keyboard clicks, soft monitor hum

scenes.title: The Question
scenes.intent: Human dialogue frames the problem. Dr. Salizar answers with a gesture, and the camera follows her gesture into the machine.

shots.description: Slow orbit around Noé and Dr. Salizar at the MRI station while he asks.
She smiles and gestures; the camera pans with her hand to the research workstation, which wakes.
Push into the monitor until the interface fills the frame and becomes a world.

scenes.title: Introducing RadiologyML
scenes.intent: A credible, uncluttered pipeline around a holographic MRI. Confidence is shown as a model score with a caveat.

shots.description: The holographic brain MRI floats in a dark hall; data streams flow into it.
The camera arcs past six panels: input, preprocessing, pattern detection, prediction, model score, human review.

transition.description: The camera dives into the mid slice; a flash hands over to the same image laid out as pixels.

scenes.title: Enter the Machine
scenes.intent: The key cinematic moment: image, then pixel intensities, then numbers, then learned features, then computation, then prediction, then comparison with the expert label. One continuous flight.

shots.description: The MRI slice lies flat; pixels rise into columns whose height is their intensity.
Skimming the pixel field; an 8×8 patch lifts out as its real numbers.
Through four feature maps computed by convolution, ReLU and pooling.
Signals pulse through a small network to an output score, which is compared with the expert label.

scenes.title: Learning from Mistakes
scenes.intent: A false positive. The expert corrects it, and the correction goes into a controlled loop: reviewed data, offline retraining, validation, release. No instant self-modification.

shots.description: Over Dr. Salizar's shoulder: a muted-red box reads POSSIBLE FINDING on a vessel artifact.
She relabels it; the camera rises to a holographic loop of prediction, error, correction, retraining and validation.

scenes.title: A Second Pair of Eyes
scenes.intent: The system flags a new image for review; a specialist confirms. People decide, and the tool helped them notice sooner.

shots.description: A new scan arrives. An amber flag reads FLAGGED FOR REVIEW.
Dr. Salizar calls a specialist over; they study the image together.
The camera pulls back to the whole care team; the hologram shows the clinical path.

scenes.title: What Did the Machine Really Learn?
scenes.intent: Noé alone with the question. The lab dissolves into a field of real Iris measurements that organise into groups and boundaries.

shots.description: Close on Noé, thoughtful. The room starts to dissolve into light.
Data points float, group and reveal decision regions; the camera rises above the field.

scenes.title: The Machine Learning Reveal
scenes.intent: Particles spell MACHINE LEARNING; four small visuals preview the paths; the particles settle into the dataset of the lab.

shots.description: Thousands of points assemble into the words MACHINE LEARNING.
The letters fall apart into the 150 Iris points that become the lab's dataset.
